caseStudies.name: Riya M.
caseStudies.from: 1.2K followers · irregular posts · no casting enquiries
caseStudies.to: 18K+ followers · 40–80 DMs/week · 6 brand trials in 4 months
caseStudies.story: We rebuilt her grid around portfolio + lifestyle reels, fixed her bio for casting managers, and ran a weekly reel system. After 8 weeks of organic consistency we added light Meta ads for profile visits in Mumbai.

caseStudies.name: Ananya S.
caseStudies.from: Personal account · mixed personal content · low discovery
caseStudies.to: Casting-ready brand · press mentions · 3 paid collaborations
caseStudies.story: We separated personal vs professional content, built a showreel-led Instagram system, and used programmatic PR features plus ads around her play premiere. Casting pages and directors started finding her through search and shares.

caseStudies.name: Meera K.
caseStudies.to: Stable brand deals · coaching waitlist · 50K+ community
caseStudies.story: We positioned her as a premium fitness face (not only workout tips), built offer-led content, and used ads to grow women 22–35 in Bengaluru/Hyderabad. Within a quarter she had predictable brand inbound.

examples.title: How Indian talent usually grows online
points: Strong visuals + weekly reel system beats posting only when you feel like it.
Casting managers check Instagram first — bio, grid, and highlights must look professional.
Ads work after the profile looks premium; ads on a messy feed waste money.
PR and features help when you already have a clear story and portfolio.

examples.title: What “0 to good” looks like in 90 days
points: Days 1–15: audit, positioning, grid cleanup, content pillars.
Days 61–90: optional ads/PR to amplify what already works.
Outcome target: clearer brand, better quality DMs, measurable growth — not vanity only.

faq.q: Do I need to create all content myself?
faq.a: We guide the system. You (or your photographer) shoot; we plan, write, edit direction, schedule, and manage. Higher support can be arranged.
No. Those fees are for management. Media budget for Meta ads (and some PR placements) is separate and agreed monthly.

faq.q: Can my manager be on the WhatsApp group?
faq.a: Yes. Most talent accounts run with you + manager + DisplayAvenue on one private thread.
Instagram is primary for models/actresses in India. We can extend to YouTube Shorts / LinkedIn for founders on request.

closing.title: Ready to look like the brand you want to become?
closing.text: Share your Instagram handle. We’ll tell you which plan fits — Organic ₹18,000, Ads ₹35,000, or Ads + PR ₹50,000.
